question: We will suspect acute renal failure of pre-renal origin in the presence of:

options.opa: Hypotension, elevation of serum urea and creatinine levels, urine osmolarity less than 500 mOsm / kg, and fractional sodium excretion greater than 1%.
options.opb: Digestive intolerance, elevation of serum urea and creatinine levels, urine osmolarity greater than 500 mOsm / kg and fractional sodium excretion less than 1%.
options.opc: Previous intravenous administration of iodinated contrast, elevation of serum urea and creatinine levels, urine osmolarity less than 500 mOsm / kg and fractional sodium excretion greater than 1%.
options.opd: Previous administration of an aminoglycoside antibiotic, elevation of serum urea and creatinine levels and isostenuria.
